summary.text: Sandy Bartlett is a Democratic member of the Maryland House of Delegates from District 32, in Anne Arundel County, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An attorney, she has served in the House since January 2019 and chairs the Judiciary Committee.

paragraphs.text: Bartlett was born in Washington, D.C., and earned a B.A. in English from Howard University in 1987 and a J.D. from the Catholic University of America's Columbus School of Law in 2007.

She worked as a paralegal and law clerk at several firms, was trademark department manager at Sughrue Mion from 2008 to 2011, and has been principal of the Law Office of Sandy Bartlett since 2015; she was also an adjunct professor at Anne Arundel Community College from 2016 to 2019.
Bartlett was first elected to the House of Delegates in 2018.
She has been chair of the Judiciary Committee since 2026, having served as its vice chair from 2023 to 2026, and also sits on the Rules and Executive Nominations Committee.
She was a Deputy Majority Whip from 2020 to 2024.
